decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful green creatures and ramping up mana using card draw and mana dorks. The deck aims to quickly build up devotion to green in order to utilize cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Storm the Festival for massive advantage and board presence. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Karn, the Great Creator further adds to the deck's versatility in both ramping and controlling the battlefield. Additionally, the deck also includes removal options like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Nicol Bolas, Dragon-God for added pressure.

The deck focuses on aggressive play, using creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Reckless Stormseeker to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Combat Celebrant and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker for extra combat phases and pressure. The deck utilizes mana ramp with Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to quickly bring out powerful threats like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures and powerful spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on early disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while deploying threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger to quickly close out the game. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester can help maintain pressure on the opponent, while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Misery's Shadow provide additional reach and card advantage. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, prioritizing efficient removal and resilient threats to overwhelm opponents in the Pioneer format.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of efficient removal spells and powerful creatures with graveyard synergies. The goal is to apply early pressure with creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats and graveyard recursion, allowing for a relentless and versatile aggro strategy. The deck aims to close out games quickly while maintaining control over the board with a mix of removal and resilient threats.

The main idea of this deck is to assemble Lotus Field using various tutors and ramp spells, allowing for explosive mana generation. Once Lotus Field is in play, the deck can cast powerful spells like Omniscience, Emergent Ultimatum, and Behold the Beyond for huge value. The deck also includes protection with cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Lier, Disciple of the Drowned. Overall, the key concept is to quickly set up a powerful mana engine with Lotus Field and leverage it to cast game-winning spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on applying constant pressure on the opponent through early game aggression and disruption with cards like Bonecrusher Giant, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Thoughtseize. It also utilizes powerful threats like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to maintain board presence and close out the game quickly. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill to deal with opposing threats, while also incorporating utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear for additional card advantage and damage output.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Indomitable Creativity to create powerful combos and generate massive value. By carefully managing resources and timing the plays correctly, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of powerful creatures and spells, setting up a win condition with cards like Xenagos, God of Revels and Worldspine Wurm. The creativity and innovation in card choices and interactions make this deck a versatile and unpredictable force to be reckoned with in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

The deck revolves around the key interaction between Lotus Field and various cards that allow for quick mana generation and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Arboreal Grazer, Sylvan Scrying, and Hidden Strings, the deck aims to quickly ramp up mana production and find key combo pieces such as Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The goal is to create a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of big spells and untapping effects. The deck's strength lies in its ability to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The key concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly deploy powerful flying creatures like Righteous Valkyrie and Resplendent Angel, while also gaining life through cards like Bishop of Wings and Youthful Valkyrie. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggro creatures and disruptive spells like Skyclave Apparition and Portable Hole, while also having the option to generate card advantage with Collected Company. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive game plan while also providing consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing key cards to create powerful combos and out-of-the-box strategies. It involves a mix of creature removal, card draw, and ramp to set up for game-changing plays such as casting Indomitable Creativity to potentially cheat out massive threats like Worldspine Wurm or Shark Typhoon. The creativity lies in the versatile use of the cards to disrupt opponents and ultimately win through overwhelming board presence or surprise tactics. The deck aims to surprise and overwhelm opponents with unexpected and innovative plays.

This UW Control deck aims to dominate the game by disrupting opponents with efficient counterspells and removal spells while drawing cards and controlling the board. It focuses on playing defensively until it can establish a powerful board presence with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon. The deck also includes a mix of offensive and defensive spells to adapt to different matchups. With a solid mana base and a variety of ways to control the game, this deck is designed to outlast opponents and secure victory through attrition.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells, removing threats, and drawing cards to maintain control of the game. With a mix of counter spells like Dovin's Veto and Censor, removal spells like Supreme Verdict and Memory Deluge, and card advantage engines like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Shark Typhoon, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent until it can secure a win condition, such as attacking with Shark tokens or landing a big threat like The Wandering Emperor. It also includes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Vantress to further control the game state.

The main focus of this deck is to ramp up quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, as well as enchantments like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven. This allows for the casting of powerful green creatures like Old-Growth Troll, Elder Gargaroth, and Polukranos, World Eater. The deck also utilizes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. Additionally, the inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator provides utility and disruption against opponents. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm and outpace opponents with its aggressive green devotion strategy.

The main concept of this deck is centered around utilizing green devotion to ramp up mana quickly and play powerful green creatures and planeswalkers. The deck aims to be aggressive with a combination of mana acceleration cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and powerful threats like Old-Growth Troll and Cavalier of Thorns. The inclusion of cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help ensure a steady stream of threats while also providing card advantage. This deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its efficient mana ramp and strong creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. Utilizing cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Bonecrusher Giant, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional threats and value. The deck also includes a mix of removal spells and card draw to help maintain tempo and control the board.

The main concept of this deck is to use Lotus Field along with cards like Pore Over the Pages, Hidden Strings, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate a large amount of mana quickly and efficiently. By using cards like Dark Petition and Emergent Ultimatum, you can search for key combo pieces like Omniscience and Behold the Beyond to set up game-winning plays. The inclusion of Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect your combo spells from countermagic, while cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Mastermind's Acquisition provide added flexibility and recursion to ensure your combo goes off successfully.
